name: searchgres-workspace
description: Workspace root for searchgres.js. Not published.

scripts.compile: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && ./bun run build && ./bun run --filter @searchgres/cli compile
scripts.compile:all: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && ./bun run build && ./bun run --filter @searchgres/cli compile:all
scripts.typecheck: ./bun run --filter searchgres build && ./bun run --filter searchgres typecheck && ./bun run --filter @searchgres/cli typecheck && ./bun x tsc -p examples/tsconfig.json
scripts.test:unit: ./bun run --filter searchgres build && ./bun run --filter searchgres test:unit && ./bun run --filter @searchgres/cli test:unit && ./bun test ./scripts/*.test.ts
scripts.test:db: ./bun run compile && ./bun run --filter searchgres test:db && SEARCHGRES_TEST_POSTGRES_JS=4 ./bun run --filter searchgres test:db && ./bun run --filter @searchgres/cli test:db && ./bun run test:package
scripts.check: ./bun run check:filter-grammar && ./bun run check:sql && ./bun run typecheck && ./bun run lint && ./bun run test:unit
scripts.pg:up: ./bun run pg:build && docker run -d --name searchgres-postgres --shm-size=1g -e POSTGRES_HOST_AUTH_METHOD=trust -p 127.0.0.1:5432:5432 searchgres-postgres
